continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

title: TeammateIdle hook output
description: Can keep the teammate working. Exit code 2 does too, with stderr as feedback. continue: false lets it go idle even if another hook blocks. onFailure has no effect on this event.
